children: CareCloud appointed Bonnie Boyer as Chief Financial Officer effective October 1, 2026, with Norman Roth transitioning to Advisor to the Chief Executive Officer.
Chief Financial Officer (will succeed Interim CFO)
Advisor to the Chief Executive Officer; Corporate Controller
Will transition from Interim CFO to Advisor (also serves as Corporate Controller)
Will succeed Norman Roth (Interim Chief Financial Officer)

Joined CareCloud July 9, 2026; former CFO of Guident Corp. (led IPO readiness); prior roles include Chief Accounting Officer at Sagent M&C, VP Finance, senior finance roles at KEMET, external reporting at Ryder, and KPMG; Florida-licensed CPA; 15+ years finance leadership
Also serves as Corporate Controller (no further background disclosed)

title: CareCloud appoints Bonnie Boyer as CFO; Norman Roth becomes Advisor to CEO
